decisions.reason: Schlager compilations still appeal to a dedicated older CD-buying audience and fit our broad catalog.
The illustrated series adds unique value and strengthens our brand among collectors.
Jazz vinyl reissues align with the growing vinyl market and our established reissue expertise.
Multi-disc box sets attract high-value collectors and reinforce our curated image.
A generic compilation CD lacks differentiation and received only minor website exposure, making it a likely candidate for discontinuation.
